fun_facts: Omarion Hampton was born in Clayton, North Carolina.
At Cleveland High School in Clayton, he rushed for 5,370 yards and 88 touchdowns. He also averaged 10.4 yards per carry and 127.8 rushing yards per game.
In a 2024 game against Florida State, Omarion Hampton scored five touchdowns: four rushing and one on a 49-yard catch.
His 2,033 all-purpose yards in 2024 set a North Carolina single-season school record.
Across his three seasons at North Carolina, he had 19 games with at least 100 rushing yards—the third-most nationally over that span.

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Thursday, April 24, 2025**

## **Chargers Select Omarion Hampton in First Round of 2025 NFL Draft**

### The Los Angeles Chargers selected North Carolina running back **Omarion Hampton** with the No. 22 overall pick in the 2025 NFL Draft. He is the eighth Tar Heel ever drafted by the Bolts and the first since 2010. Hampton finished his career at North Carolina as one of the most prolific running backs in college football, ranking No. 2 in the nation over the last two years with 3,164 rushing yards. He was the only back in the nation to eclipse at least 1,500 rushing yards and 15 rushing scores in each of the last two seasons, earning _Associated Press_ second-team All-America and first-team All-Atlantic Coast Conference recognition each year.

# Hampton scores 5 TDs, Brown gets first win over Florida State as North Carolina rolls to 35-11 win

* * *

By AP

Nov 2, 2024, 09:08 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

TALLAHASSEE, Fla. -- — [Omarion Hampton](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4685382/omarion-hampton) had four touchdown runs and a 49-yard TD reception as North Carolina cruised to a 35-11 victory over Florida State on Saturday.

Hampton racked up 172 rushing yards and 93 receiving yards and now has 14 touchdowns for UNC (5-4, 2/3 Atlantic Coast Conference).

Hampton is a man of many yards but not so many words.
